chunks: With this chain of transmission, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from a number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ibn Abi Najran, from some of his companions, from Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
The least amount of camphor that suffices for the deceased is one mithqal.

key_terms.الْكَافُورِ: camphor used in the rites of preparing the deceased
key_terms.مِثْقَالٌ: a mithqal, a unit of weight
key_terms.يُجْزِي: is sufficient or fulfills the required minimum

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount of camphor that suffices for the deceased in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum amount of camphor sufficient for use with the deceased in funeral preparation. It serves as a concise fiqh ruling related to the rites of washing and preparing the dead.
